description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of products in a catalog within an Android application. It manages product item views, supports pagination with a loading footer, handles updates such as favorite toggling and countdown timers for sales, and includes UI animations respecting accessibility settings.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for product catalog items, managing product data, UI updates, animations, and pagination footer.

classes.name: ProductVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual product item views, including binding data, handling favorite toggles, sale badges, countdowns, and UI animations.

classes.name: LoadingVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for displaying a loading indicator at the bottom of the list during pagination.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Replaces the entire product list, used when query/filters/sort change or paging resets.

methods.name: submitWithFooter
methods.description: Replaces the list and toggles the loading footer.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends additional products to the existing list, supporting smooth DiffUtil animations during pagination.

methods.name: setLoadingFooterVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides the loading footer at the end of the list.

methods.name: notifyFavoriteChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a specific product's favorite status has changed, updating just that item.

methods.name: startCountdownTicker
methods.description: Initiates the periodic countdown updates every second for visible product items.
